modelFields.coverageLabel: Source-linked full-credit curriculum with proposed approved-course choices; transfer matches require separate evidence.
rulesNotes: A 120-credit proposed allocation: 27 unique general education + 15 foundations + 57 major/capstone/elective credits + 21 free-elective credits.

The published sequence uses BIOL 102 as natural science, ENGL 102 as information literacy, MATH 201 or PSYC 354 as mathematics, and PSYC 101 as social science. These 12 foundation credits are counted once.
The capstone scenario uses three credits. Selecting a six-credit internship or a three-credit UNIV 104 changes elective allocation and may increase the published 120–129-credit course sequence total.
Advanced mental-health practice, therapy or professional counseling may require graduate education and appropriate licensure; the bachelor degree alone does not establish that eligibility.
The source prints UNIV 104 as 0–3 credits; zero credits are a scenario requiring individual confirmation.
Do not automatically remove RLGN 104 at 45 transfer credits or THEO 104 at 60 transfer credits. The source permits those waivers, but this ledger retains both courses until individual evaluation.
unresolved: Confirm individual catalog eligibility, major-course residency allocation, course prerequisites, and written transfer evaluation.
Outside-course equivalencies must be sourced separately; a university requirement is not evidence that a particular accelerated course transfers.
State-specific online general-education requirements may differ; consult the applicable state degree completion plan.

graduationRequirements.title: Graduation application
graduationRequirements.detail: Submit the degree completion application within the last semester of the anticipated graduation date.

graduationRequirements.title: Major course grades
graduationRequirements.detail: At least C in the requirements under the catalog major section, including its listed foundations and other named major sections.

obligations.title: UNIV 104 evaluation
obligations.notes: The degree plan lists UNIV 104 as 0–3 credits. This proposed ledger uses the zero-credit case. Obtain Liberty confirmation; if 3 credits are required, adjust elective allocation within the printed range or retain additional graduation credit.

obligations.title: HSER 465 and capstone/internship approval
obligations.notes: The source lists zero-credit HSER 465 internship proposal/preparation. Confirm its applicability and required department approval for the selected capstone or internship route; zero credits do not remove an obligation.

gradePolicy.detail: At least C in the requirements under the catalog major section, including its listed foundations and other named major sections.

exclusions: The full-time rate requires at least 12 semester credits; eight-week subterms are not separate billing semesters.
Program-specific, military and other eligibility-based rates are outside this standard-rate model.
Technology, completion and course-specific fees remain separate.

publishedFees.label: Online technology fee
publishedFees.eligibility: Standard online fee; waived for actively serving military and their spouses under the published policy.

institutionMinCredits.calculation: 25% of this published degree total must be completed at Liberty.

externalMaxCredits.calculation: Published degree total less the 25% institutional minimum.
externalMaxCredits.scope: Overall outside-credit ceiling only. This does not establish a separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling or a particular provider award.

majorInstitutionFraction.scope: 25% of the exact major/minor component, unless the degree completion plan specifies otherwise. The denominator remains degree-specific.

policyReview.message: The reviewed online undergraduate catalog publishes no separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling. Its documented overall transfer and degree/major residency rules remain enforced. Each outside course still requires its own published receiving award and provider eligibility; no numeric alternative-credit allowance or student award is inferred.

onlineGuideAwardReview.scope: Exact receiving awards and proposed degree placements only; provider quantities and eligibility remain separate.
